description:
Preorder now and take the fight to the Dragon Lords:
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/dragonkin-the-banished/9NX9TLX2LKJ2/

Home is where your loot is! 

Multiple players can call the city of Montescail their home. Invite friends, work together to unlock new facilities and open new districts, upgrade your vendors and watch your city grow in real time. 

And for those who prefer solo-play, all of this is doable fully offline!

In this action-ARPG, play solo, in local co-op (2-player) or any combination of up to 4 players online, build your city, and your legacy as you tear through the Dragonkin, unlock new abilities, and find near gear.

Train your wyrmling, find a gameplay style that suits you, and clear out the Dragon Hordes in Dragonkin - The Banished. Coming to Xbox Series X|S on March 19th.

description:
Can a friendship change the world? Now is the time to find out. Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf is available on Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9pl89b9hcz9w 

Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf is a cinematic puzzle-adventure that continues the story of Lana and her loyal companion, Mui. Explore the hand-painted world of Novo as new forces threaten their home, and work together to overcome obstacles, outsmart dangers, and protect what matters most.

Experience a richer story, more demanding puzzles, and enhanced companion abilities - all brought to life by stunning visuals and a sweeping orchestral soundtrack by Takeshi Furukawa.

This is a standalone story - whether you’re returning to Novo or discovering it for the first time.

Begin your journey today.

Peace is a forgotten word on a continent ravaged by endless war and the deadly Malichor plague. Ripped from your native island of Teer Fradee, you are now their last hope, as the cure may lie within your homeland. As you fight for your people's survival, a charismatic leader rises, promising to end the bloodshed through absolute control.

Must a world be broken to be saved?
